model.name: openai/gpt-5.5
model.about: OpenAI: GPT-5.5, through OpenRouter at $5 in and $30 out per million tokens.

answers.sql:
SELECT
    COALESCE(ch.DSPLY_NM, ch.BUS_CD1, 'Unknown') AS channel,
    COUNT(*) AS account_transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN AS txn
LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL AS ch
    ON txn.CHNL_K = ch.CHNL_K
LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS dt
    ON txn.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY COALESCE(ch.DSPLY_NM, ch.BUS_CD1, 'Unknown')
ORDER BY account_transaction_count DESC, channel;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_customer_count
FROM bank_dwh."D_CUST"
WHERE "IS_CURR" IS TRUE
  AND "IS_ACTV" IS TRUE;

SELECT
    COALESCE(j.DSPLY_NM, j.JUR_CD1, 'Unknown') AS jurisdiction,
    COUNT(*) AS aml_alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT AS a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d
    ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR AS j
    ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY COALESCE(j.DSPLY_NM, j.JUR_CD1, 'Unknown')
ORDER BY aml_alert_count DESC, jurisdiction;

SELECT
    br.BR_K AS branch_key,
    br.BUS_ID AS branch_business_id,
    br.BUS_CD1 AS branch_code,
    br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
    COUNT(*) AS atm_transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN AS atm
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS dt
    ON atm.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR AS br
    ON atm.BR_K = br.BR_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY
    br.BR_K,
    br.BUS_ID,
    br.BUS_CD1,
    br.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY
    atm_transaction_count DESC,
    br.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS card_dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT AS dspt
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS dt
  ON dspt.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT f.CUST_K) AS defaulted_client_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D AS f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d
    ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND d.MTH_NBR = 8
  AND d.IS_MTH_END = TRUE
  AND f.DFLT_FLG = TRUE
  AND f.CUST_K IS NOT NULL;

SELECT
  COALESCE(cctg.DSPLY_NM, 'Unknown') AS complaint_category,
  COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT AS f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG AS cctg
  ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = cctg.CMPLT_CTG_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY COALESCE(cctg.DSPLY_NM, 'Unknown')
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC, complaint_category;

SELECT
    d.cal_dt AS business_date,
    COALESCE(c.iso_alph_cd1, f.ccy_cd1) AS currency_code,
    c.ccy_nm AS currency_name,
    AVG(f.avrg_rt) AS average_daily_fx_rate
FROM bank_dwh.f_fx_rt_d AS f
JOIN bank_dwh.d_dt AS d
    ON f.bus_dt_k = d.dt_k
LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.d_ccy AS c
    ON f.ccy_k = c.ccy_k
WHERE d.cal_yr_nbr = 2025
GROUP BY
    d.cal_dt,
    COALESCE(c.iso_alph_cd1, f.ccy_cd1),
    c.ccy_nm
ORDER BY
    d.cal_dt,
    currency_code;

SELECT
    COALESCE(v.MKT_ID, p.MKT_CD1, 'UNKNOWN') AS market,
    SUM(v.MKT_VAL1_AMT) AS total_market_value_amount,
    SUM(v.BOOK_VAL1_AMT) AS total_book_value_amount,
    SUM(v.NET_ASST_VAL1_AMT) AS total_net_asset_value_amount,
    COUNT(*) AS valuation_row_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_PTF_VAL_D AS v
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d
    ON v.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.D_PTF AS p
    ON v.PTF_K = p.PTF_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY COALESCE(v.MKT_ID, p.MKT_CD1, 'UNKNOWN')
ORDER BY market;

SELECT
    a.acct_typ_cd1 AS account_type_code,
    COUNT(*) AS accounts_opened_count
FROM bank_dwh.d_acct AS a
WHERE a.opnd_dt >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND a.opnd_dt < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND a.is_curr IS TRUE
GROUP BY
    a.acct_typ_cd1
ORDER BY
    a.acct_typ_cd1;

SELECT
    br.cty_nm AS branch_city,
    COUNT(*) AS atm_transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.f_atm_txn AS atm
JOIN bank_dwh.d_dt AS dt
    ON atm.bus_dt_k = dt.dt_k
JOIN bank_dwh.d_br AS br
    ON atm.br_k = br.br_k
WHERE dt.cal_yr_nbr = 2025
  AND dt.qtr_nbr = 1
GROUP BY br.cty_nm
ORDER BY br.cty_nm;

SELECT
    AVG(f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS avg_account_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D AS f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d
    ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-06-30';

SELECT
    AVG(f.MID_RT) AS avg_mid_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D AS f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d
    ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.CCY_CD1 = 'USD'
  AND d.CAL_DT >= DATE '2025-12-01'
  AND d.CAL_DT < DATE '2026-01-01';

SELECT
    c.cust_sgmnt_cd1 AS customer_segment,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.bus_id) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.d_cust AS c
WHERE c.is_curr IS TRUE
GROUP BY c.cust_sgmnt_cd1
ORDER BY c.cust_sgmnt_cd1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.BUS_ID
    FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST AS c
    WHERE c.BUS_ID IS NOT NULL
) AS customers
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN AS t
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d
      ON d.DT_K = t.BUS_DT_K
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST AS tc
      ON tc.CUST_K = t.CUST_K
    WHERE tc.BUS_ID = customers.BUS_ID
      AND d.CAL_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND d.CAL_DT < DATE '2026-01-01'
);

SELECT
  100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.pmt_sts_cd1 = 'DECLINED') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS declined_authorization_percentage
FROM bank_dwh.f_cd_auth AS a
JOIN bank_dwh.d_dt AS d
  ON a.bus_dt_k = d.dt_k
WHERE d.cal_yr_nbr = 2025;

SELECT
    c.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category_name,
    COUNT(*) AS escalated_complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT AS f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG AS c
    ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = c.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d
    ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.IS_ESCLT IS TRUE
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY c.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT
    SUM(dspt.TXN_AMT) AS total_transaction_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT AS dspt
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS dt
    ON dspt.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND dspt.DSPT_RSN_CD1 = 'FRAUD';

SELECT
    j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name,
    COUNT(*) AS aml_alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT AS a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR AS j
    ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d
    ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE a.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY j.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.LN_ID) AS loans_more_than_90_days_past_due
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_RPMT AS r
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d
  ON r.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-08-31'
  AND r.DYS_PST_DUE > 90
  AND r.LN_ID IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.cust_k) AS distinct_sme_customers
FROM bank_dwh.f_wr_trf AS w
JOIN bank_dwh.d_cust AS c
  ON w.cust_k = c.cust_k
JOIN bank_dwh.d_dt AS d
  ON w.bus_dt_k = d.dt_k
WHERE c.cust_sgmnt_cd1 = 'SME'
  AND w.is_crss_brdr IS TRUE
  AND d.cal_yr_nbr = 2025;

WITH branch_atm_txn_counts AS (
    SELECT
        br.RGN_CD1 AS region_code,
        br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
        COUNT(*) AS atm_transaction_count
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN AS f
    INNER JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR AS br
        ON f.BR_K = br.BR_K
    INNER JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS dt
        ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    GROUP BY
        br.RGN_CD1,
        br.DSPLY_NM
), ranked_branches AS (
    SELECT
        region_code,
        branch_name,
        atm_transaction_count,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY region_code
            ORDER BY atm_transaction_count DESC
        ) AS txn_rank
    FROM branch_atm_txn_counts
)
SELECT
    region_code,
    branch_name,
    atm_transaction_count
FROM ranked_branches
WHERE txn_rank = 1
ORDER BY region_code, branch_name;

SELECT
    c.bus_id AS customer_business_id,
    SUM(w.orgnl_amt) AS total_wire_transfer_amount
FROM bank_dwh.f_wr_trf AS w
JOIN bank_dwh.d_cust AS c
    ON w.cust_k = c.cust_k
JOIN bank_dwh.d_dt AS d
    ON w.bus_dt_k = d.dt_k
WHERE d.cal_yr_nbr = 2025
GROUP BY c.bus_id
ORDER BY total_wire_transfer_amount DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
    COALESCE(wt.CCY_CD1, c.ISO_ALPH_CD1, c.BUS_CD1) AS currency_code,
    SUM(wt.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF AS wt
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d
    ON wt.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY AS c
    ON wt.CCY_K = c.CCY_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY COALESCE(wt.CCY_CD1, c.ISO_ALPH_CD1, c.BUS_CD1)
ORDER BY currency_code;

WITH wire_customers_2025 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT w.CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF AS w
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d
      ON w.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
      AND w.CUST_K IS NOT NULL
),
atm_customers_2025 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN AS a
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d
      ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
      AND a.CUST_K IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_customer_count
FROM wire_customers_2025 AS w
JOIN atm_customers_2025 AS a
  ON w.CUST_K = a.CUST_K;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF AS f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT
    d.CAL_YR_NBR AS calendar_year,
    COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF AS w
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d
    ON w.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY d.CAL_YR_NBR;

SELECT
    br.BR_K,
    br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
    AVG(c.ANNL_INCM_AMT) AS average_annual_income_amount
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST AS c
JOIN bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D AS f
    ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR AS br
    ON br.BR_K = f.BR_K
GROUP BY
    br.BR_K,
    br.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY
    br.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT
    br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name
FROM bank_dwh.D_BR AS br
WHERE br.IS_CURR IS TRUE
ORDER BY br.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT
    COALESCE(ch.DSPLY_NM, ch.BUS_CD1, 'Unknown') AS channel,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN AS txn
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS dt
    ON txn.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL AS ch
    ON txn.CHNL_K = ch.CHNL_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY COALESCE(ch.DSPLY_NM, ch.BUS_CD1, 'Unknown')
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, channel;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_customer_count
FROM bank_dwh."D_CUST" AS c
WHERE c."IS_CURR" IS TRUE
  AND c."IS_ACTV" IS TRUE;

SELECT
    COALESCE(j.DSPLY_NM, j.JUR_CD1, j.BUS_CD1, 'Unknown') AS jurisdiction,
    COUNT(*) AS aml_alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT AS a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d
    ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR AS j
    ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY COALESCE(j.DSPLY_NM, j.JUR_CD1, j.BUS_CD1, 'Unknown')
ORDER BY aml_alert_count DESC, jurisdiction;

SELECT
    br.BR_K AS branch_key,
    br.BUS_ID AS branch_business_id,
    br.BUS_CD1 AS branch_code,
    br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
    COUNT(*) AS atm_transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN AS atm
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS dt
    ON atm.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR AS br
    ON atm.BR_K = br.BR_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY
    br.BR_K,
    br.BUS_ID,
    br.BUS_CD1,
    br.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY
    atm_transaction_count DESC,
    branch_key;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS card_disputes_recorded
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT AS dspt
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS dt
  ON dspt.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT dlq.CUST_K) AS clients_in_default_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D AS dlq
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS dt
    ON dlq.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-08-31'
  AND dlq.DFLT_FLG IS TRUE;

SELECT
    COALESCE(ctg.DSPLY_NM, 'Uncategorized') AS complaint_category,
    COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT AS f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d
    ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG AS ctg
    ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = ctg.CMPLT_CTG_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY COALESCE(ctg.DSPLY_NM, 'Uncategorized')
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC, complaint_category;

SELECT
    d.CAL_DT AS rate_date,
    COALESCE(c.ISO_ALPH_CD1, f.CCY_CD1) AS currency_code,
    AVG(f.AVRG_RT) AS average_daily_fx_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D AS f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d
    ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY AS c
    ON f.CCY_K = c.CCY_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND d.CAL_DT < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY
    d.CAL_DT,
    COALESCE(c.ISO_ALPH_CD1, f.CCY_CD1)
ORDER BY
    d.CAL_DT,
    currency_code;

SELECT
    COALESCE(v.MKT_ID, 'UNKNOWN') AS market_id,
    SUM(v.MKT_VAL1_AMT) AS total_market_value_amount,
    SUM(v.NET_ASST_VAL1_AMT) AS total_net_asset_value_amount,
    COUNT(*) AS valuation_row_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_PTF_VAL_D AS v
INNER JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d
    ON v.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY COALESCE(v.MKT_ID, 'UNKNOWN')
ORDER BY market_id;

SELECT
  a.acct_typ_cd1 AS account_type_code,
  COUNT(*) AS accounts_opened_count
FROM bank_dwh.d_acct AS a
WHERE a.opnd_dt >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND a.opnd_dt < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY a.acct_typ_cd1
ORDER BY a.acct_typ_cd1;

SELECT
  br.cty_nm AS branch_city,
  COUNT(*) AS atm_transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.f_atm_txn AS atm
JOIN bank_dwh.d_dt AS dt
  ON atm.bus_dt_k = dt.dt_k
JOIN bank_dwh.d_br AS br
  ON atm.br_k = br.br_k
WHERE dt.cal_dt >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND dt.cal_dt < DATE '2025-04-01'
GROUP BY br.cty_nm
ORDER BY br.cty_nm;

SELECT
    AVG(f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS avg_account_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D AS f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d
    ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-06-30';

SELECT
  AVG(f.MID_RT) AS avg_mid_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D AS f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.CCY_CD1 = 'USD'
  AND d.CAL_DT >= DATE '2025-12-01'
  AND d.CAL_DT < DATE '2026-01-01';

SELECT
    c.cust_sgmnt_cd1 AS customer_segment,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.bus_id) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.d_cust AS c
WHERE c.is_curr IS TRUE
GROUP BY c.cust_sgmnt_cd1
ORDER BY c.cust_sgmnt_cd1;

WITH customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.bus_id
    FROM bank_dwh.d_cust AS c
    WHERE c.bus_id IS NOT NULL
), customers_with_2025_account_txn AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.bus_id
    FROM bank_dwh.f_acct_txn AS t
    JOIN bank_dwh.d_dt AS d
      ON d.dt_k = t.bus_dt_k
    JOIN bank_dwh.d_cust AS c
      ON c.cust_k = t.cust_k
    WHERE c.bus_id IS NOT NULL
      AND d.cal_dt >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND d.cal_dt <  DATE '2026-01-01'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count_no_account_transaction_2025
FROM customers AS c
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM customers_with_2025_account_txn AS tx
    WHERE tx.bus_id = c.bus_id
);

SELECT
  100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.pmt_sts_cd1 = 'DECLINED') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS declined_authorization_percentage
FROM bank_dwh.f_cd_auth AS a
JOIN bank_dwh.d_dt AS d
  ON a.bus_dt_k = d.dt_k
WHERE d.cal_yr_nbr = 2025;

SELECT
    c.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category_name,
    COUNT(*) AS escalated_complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT AS f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG AS c
    ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = c.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d
    ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.IS_ESCLT = TRUE
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY c.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT
    SUM(d.TXN_AMT) AS total_transaction_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT AS d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS dt
    ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND d.DSPT_RSN_CD1 = 'FRAUD';

SELECT
    j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name,
    COUNT(*) AS aml_alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT AS a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR AS j
    ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d
    ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE a.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY j.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT r.LN_ID) AS loans_more_than_90_days_past_due
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_RPMT AS r
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d
    ON r.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-08-31'
  AND r.DYS_PST_DUE > 90;

SELECT
    p.dsply_nm AS loan_product_name,
    SUM(f.otstn_prncp_amt) AS total_outstanding_loan_principal
FROM bank_dwh.f_ln_dlq_d AS f
JOIN bank_dwh.d_dt AS d
    ON f.bus_dt_k = d.dt_k
JOIN bank_dwh.d_ln_prd AS p
    ON f.ln_prd_k = p.ln_prd_k
WHERE d.cal_dt = DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY p.dsply_nm
ORDER BY p.dsply_nm;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.cust_k) AS distinct_sme_customers_with_cross_border_wire_transfer
FROM bank_dwh.f_wr_trf AS w
JOIN bank_dwh.d_cust AS c
  ON w.cust_k = c.cust_k
JOIN bank_dwh.d_dt AS d
  ON w.bus_dt_k = d.dt_k
WHERE c.cust_sgmnt_cd1 = 'SME'
  AND w.is_crss_brdr IS TRUE
  AND d.cal_yr_nbr = 2025;

WITH branch_atm_txn_counts AS (
    SELECT
        br.RGN_CD1 AS region_code,
        br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
        COUNT(*) AS atm_transaction_count
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN AS atm
    INNER JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR AS br
        ON atm.BR_K = br.BR_K
    INNER JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS dt
        ON atm.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    GROUP BY
        br.RGN_CD1,
        br.DSPLY_NM
), ranked_branches AS (
    SELECT
        region_code,
        branch_name,
        atm_transaction_count,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY region_code
            ORDER BY atm_transaction_count DESC
        ) AS txn_rank
    FROM branch_atm_txn_counts
)
SELECT
    region_code,
    branch_name,
    atm_transaction_count
FROM ranked_branches
WHERE txn_rank = 1
ORDER BY region_code, branch_name;

SELECT
    c.bus_id AS customer_business_id,
    SUM(wt.orgnl_amt) AS total_wire_transfer_amount
FROM bank_dwh.f_wr_trf AS wt
JOIN bank_dwh.d_cust AS c
    ON wt.cust_k = c.cust_k
JOIN bank_dwh.d_dt AS d
    ON wt.bus_dt_k = d.dt_k
WHERE d.cal_yr_nbr = 2025
GROUP BY c.bus_id
ORDER BY total_wire_transfer_amount DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 5;

WITH wire_customers_2025 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT w.CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF AS w
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d
      ON w.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
      AND w.CUST_K IS NOT NULL
),
atm_customers_2025 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN AS a
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d
      ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
      AND a.CUST_K IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_customers_both_wire_and_atm_2025
FROM wire_customers_2025 AS w
JOIN atm_customers_2025 AS a
  ON w.CUST_K = a.CUST_K;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF AS w
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d
  ON w.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT
    d.CAL_YR_NBR AS transfer_year,
    COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF AS w
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d
    ON w.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY d.CAL_YR_NBR;

SELECT
    br.BR_K AS branch_key,
    br.BUS_ID AS branch_business_id,
    br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
    AVG(c.ANNL_INCM_AMT) AS average_annual_income_amount
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST AS c
JOIN bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D AS f
    ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR AS br
    ON br.BR_K = f.BR_K
WHERE c.ANNL_INCM_AMT IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
    br.BR_K,
    br.BUS_ID,
    br.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY
    br.DSPLY_NM,
    br.BR_K;

SELECT
  br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name
FROM bank_dwh.D_BR AS br
WHERE br.IS_CURR IS TRUE
ORDER BY br.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT
    c.CUST_K,
    c.BUS_ID,
    c.DSPLY_NM,
    c.CTY_NM,
    c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS current_customer_segment,
    'AFFLUENT'::varchar(50) AS proposed_customer_segment
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST AS c
WHERE c.CTY_NM = 'Cluj-Napoca'
  AND c.IS_CURR IS TRUE
ORDER BY c.CUST_K;

SELECT
    COALESCE(ch.DSPLY_NM, ch.BUS_CD1, 'Unknown') AS channel,
    COUNT(*) AS account_transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN AS txn
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS dt
    ON txn.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL AS ch
    ON txn.CHNL_K = ch.CHNL_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY COALESCE(ch.DSPLY_NM, ch.BUS_CD1, 'Unknown')
ORDER BY account_transaction_count DESC, channel;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_customer_count
FROM bank_dwh."D_CUST"
WHERE "IS_CURR" IS TRUE
  AND "IS_ACTV" IS TRUE;

SELECT
    COALESCE(j.DSPLY_NM, j.JUR_CD1, j.CNTRY_CD1, 'Unknown') AS jurisdiction,
    COUNT(*) AS aml_alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT AS a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d
    ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR AS j
    ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY COALESCE(j.DSPLY_NM, j.JUR_CD1, j.CNTRY_CD1, 'Unknown')
ORDER BY aml_alert_count DESC, jurisdiction;

SELECT
    br.BR_K AS branch_key,
    br.BUS_ID AS branch_business_id,
    br.BUS_CD1 AS branch_code,
    br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
    COUNT(*) AS atm_transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN AS atm
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS dt
    ON atm.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR AS br
    ON atm.BR_K = br.BR_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY
    br.BR_K,
    br.BUS_ID,
    br.BUS_CD1,
    br.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY
    atm_transaction_count DESC,
    branch_key;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS card_dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT AS dspt
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS dt
  ON dspt.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT dlq.CUST_K) AS clients_in_default_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D AS dlq
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS dt
    ON dlq.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-08-31'
  AND dlq.DFLT_FLG IS TRUE;

SELECT
    COALESCE(ctg.DSPLY_NM, ctg.BUS_CD1, 'Uncategorized') AS complaint_category,
    COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT AS f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d
    ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG AS ctg
    ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = ctg.CMPLT_CTG_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY COALESCE(ctg.DSPLY_NM, ctg.BUS_CD1, 'Uncategorized')
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC, complaint_category;

SELECT
    dt.cal_dt AS rate_date,
    COALESCE(ccy.iso_alph_cd1, fx.ccy_cd1) AS currency_code,
    AVG(fx.avrg_rt) AS average_daily_fx_rate
FROM bank_dwh.f_fx_rt_d AS fx
JOIN bank_dwh.d_dt AS dt
    ON fx.bus_dt_k = dt.dt_k
LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.d_ccy AS ccy
    ON fx.ccy_k = ccy.ccy_k
WHERE dt.cal_yr_nbr = 2025
GROUP BY
    dt.cal_dt,
    COALESCE(ccy.iso_alph_cd1, fx.ccy_cd1)
ORDER BY
    dt.cal_dt,
    currency_code;

SELECT
    v.MKT_ID AS market_id,
    v.MKT_CCY_CD1 AS market_currency_code,
    SUM(v.MKT_VAL1_AMT) AS total_market_value_amount,
    SUM(v.NET_ASST_VAL1_AMT) AS total_net_asset_value_amount,
    COUNT(*) AS valuation_row_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_PTF_VAL_D AS v
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d
    ON v.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY
    v.MKT_ID,
    v.MKT_CCY_CD1
ORDER BY
    v.MKT_ID,
    v.MKT_CCY_CD1;

SELECT
    a.acct_typ_cd1 AS account_type_code,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.acct_nbr_hsh) AS accounts_opened_count
FROM bank_dwh.d_acct AS a
WHERE a.opnd_dt >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND a.opnd_dt < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY
    a.acct_typ_cd1
ORDER BY
    a.acct_typ_cd1;

SELECT
    br.cty_nm AS branch_city,
    COUNT(*) AS atm_transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.f_atm_txn AS atm
JOIN bank_dwh.d_dt AS dt
    ON atm.bus_dt_k = dt.dt_k
JOIN bank_dwh.d_br AS br
    ON atm.br_k = br.br_k
WHERE dt.cal_dt >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND dt.cal_dt < DATE '2025-04-01'
GROUP BY br.cty_nm
ORDER BY br.cty_nm;

SELECT
    AVG(f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS avg_account_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D AS f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d
    ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-06-30';

SELECT
    AVG(f.MID_RT) AS average_mid_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D AS f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d
    ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.CCY_CD1 = 'USD'
  AND d.CAL_DT >= DATE '2025-12-01'
  AND d.CAL_DT < DATE '2026-01-01';

SELECT
  dt.MTH_NBR AS month_number,
  COUNT(*) AS card_disputes_raised_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_FEE AS f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS dt
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND f.DSPT_RSN_CD1 IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY dt.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY dt.MTH_NBR;

SELECT
    c.cust_sgmnt_cd1 AS customer_segment,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.bus_id) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.d_cust AS c
WHERE c.is_curr IS TRUE
GROUP BY c.cust_sgmnt_cd1
ORDER BY c.cust_sgmnt_cd1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_with_no_account_transactions_2025
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.cust_k
    FROM bank_dwh.d_cust AS c
) AS customers
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM bank_dwh.f_acct_txn AS t
    INNER JOIN bank_dwh.d_dt AS dt
        ON dt.dt_k = t.bus_dt_k
    WHERE t.cust_k = customers.cust_k
      AND dt.cal_yr_nbr = 2025
);

SELECT
  100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.pmt_sts_cd1 = 'DECLINED') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS declined_authorization_percentage
FROM bank_dwh.f_cd_auth AS a
JOIN bank_dwh.d_dt AS d
  ON a.bus_dt_k = d.dt_k
WHERE d.cal_yr_nbr = 2025;

SELECT
    c.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category_name,
    COUNT(*) AS escalated_complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT AS f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG AS c
    ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = c.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d
    ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.IS_ESCLT IS TRUE
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY c.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT
    SUM(f.TXN_AMT) AS total_transaction_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT AS f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d
    ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.DSPT_RSN_CD1 = 'FRAUD'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT
    j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name,
    COUNT(*) AS aml_alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT AS a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR AS j
    ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d
    ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE a.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY j.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT f.ln_id) AS loans_more_than_90_days_past_due
FROM bank_dwh.f_ln_dsbrs AS f
JOIN bank_dwh.d_dt AS d
    ON f.bus_dt_k = d.dt_k
WHERE d.cal_dt = DATE '2025-08-31'
  AND f.dys_pst_due > 90
  AND f.ln_id IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.cust_k) AS distinct_sme_customers
FROM bank_dwh.f_wr_trf AS w
JOIN bank_dwh.d_cust AS c
  ON w.cust_k = c.cust_k
JOIN bank_dwh.d_dt AS d
  ON w.bus_dt_k = d.dt_k
WHERE c.cust_sgmnt_cd1 = 'SME'
  AND w.is_crss_brdr IS TRUE
  AND d.cal_yr_nbr = 2025;

WITH branch_atm_txn_counts AS (
    SELECT
        br.RGN_CD1 AS region_code,
        br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
        COUNT(*) AS atm_transaction_count
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN AS atm
    INNER JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR AS br
        ON atm.BR_K = br.BR_K
    INNER JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS dt
        ON atm.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    GROUP BY
        br.RGN_CD1,
        br.DSPLY_NM
), ranked_branches AS (
    SELECT
        region_code,
        branch_name,
        atm_transaction_count,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY region_code
            ORDER BY atm_transaction_count DESC
        ) AS txn_rank
    FROM branch_atm_txn_counts
)
SELECT
    region_code,
    branch_name,
    atm_transaction_count
FROM ranked_branches
WHERE txn_rank = 1
ORDER BY region_code, branch_name;

WITH wire_customers_2025 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT w.CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF AS w
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d
      ON w.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
      AND w.CUST_K IS NOT NULL
),
atm_customers_2025 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN AS a
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d
      ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
      AND a.CUST_K IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_customers_with_wire_and_atm_txn_2025
FROM wire_customers_2025 AS w
JOIN atm_customers_2025 AS a
  ON w.CUST_K = a.CUST_K;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF AS f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT
    d.CAL_YR_NBR AS calendar_year,
    COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF AS w
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d
    ON w.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY d.CAL_YR_NBR;

SELECT
    br.BR_K AS branch_key,
    br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
    AVG(cust.ANNL_INCM_AMT) AS average_annual_income_amount
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST AS cust
JOIN bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D AS acct_bal
    ON acct_bal.CUST_K = cust.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR AS br
    ON br.BR_K = acct_bal.BR_K
WHERE cust.ANNL_INCM_AMT IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
    br.BR_K,
    br.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY
    br.DSPLY_NM,
    br.BR_K;

SELECT
  br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name
FROM bank_dwh.D_BR AS br
WHERE br.IS_CURR IS TRUE
ORDER BY br.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT
    c.CUST_K,
    c.BUS_ID,
    c.DSPLY_NM,
    c.CTY_NM,
    c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS current_customer_segment,
    'AFFLUENT'::varchar(50) AS proposed_customer_segment
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST AS c
WHERE c.CTY_NM = 'Cluj-Napoca'
  AND c.IS_CURR IS TRUE;
